paper_title: Mapping the Minds of LLMs A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM
caption: Average number of tokens under different numbers of shots with few-shot style. Few-shot prompting leads to significantly fewer reasoning tokens compared with zero-shot prompting.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: The bar chart illustrates the average token count for two distinct components—“Reasoning” (represented by orange bars) and “Demonstration” (represented by blue bars)—across five different numbers of shots (0 through 4), under a few-shot prompting paradigm. The vertical axis, labeled “Token Count,” ranges from 0 to 7000 in increments of 1000, with horizontal dotted gridlines aiding visual alignment. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Shots,” displays discrete integer values from 0 to 4, arranged in ascending order. For each shot count, the total bar height represents the sum of reasoning and demonstration tokens, with the blue segment stacked atop the orange segment. At zero shots, the token count is entirely composed of reasoning tokens (6393), with no demonstration tokens. As the number of shots increases from 1 to 4, the orange “Reasoning” portion decreases progressively—from 4441 at 1 shot to 4214 at 4 shots—while the blue “Demonstration” portion increases correspondingly, starting at 111 for 1 shot and rising to 765 at 4 shots. Red downward-pointing arrows with numerical labels (-1952, -1613, -1040, -1379) indicate the reduction in reasoning token count relative to the zero-shot baseline for shots 1 through 4, respectively. The chart visually conveys that increasing the number of shots reduces the reliance on reasoning tokens, while introducing and incrementally increasing demonstration tokens, consistent with the caption’s claim that few-shot prompting leads to significantly fewer reasoning tokens compared to zero-shot prompting.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart illustrates the average token count for two components — “Reasoning” (orange) and “Demonstration” (blue) — across five different numbers of shots (0 through 4) in a few-shot prompting setup, as analyzed in the paper “Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM.” The vertical axis represents “Token Count,” ranging from 0 to 7000 in increments of 1000, while the horizontal axis indicates the “Number of Shots,” labeled 0 to 4. At zero shots, the total token count is 6393, entirely composed of reasoning tokens. As the number of shots increases, the reasoning token count decreases significantly — by 1952 at 1 shot, 1613 at 2 shots, 1040 at 3 shots, and 1379 at 4 shots — while demonstration tokens are introduced and grow in contribution. For instance, at 1 shot, reasoning tokens drop to approximately 4441 and demonstration tokens add ~300, totaling ~4741. At 2 shots, reasoning is ~4880 and demonstration ~300, totaling ~5180. At 3 shots, reasoning is ~5000 and demonstration ~500, totaling ~5500. At 4 shots, reasoning is ~4200 and demonstration ~800, totaling ~5000. The chart visually confirms the caption’s claim that few-shot prompting reduces reasoning tokens compared to zero-shot, while introducing demonstration tokens that partially offset the total token reduction. The red downward arrows with negative values highlight the magnitude of token reduction in reasoning as shots increase.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm stellt die durchschnittliche Anzahl an Tokens dar, die bei unterschiedlichen Anzahlen von Shots (0 bis 4) im Few-Shot-Stil verwendet werden, unterteilt in die Kategorien „Reasoning“ (orange) und „Demonstration“ (blau), wobei die Gesamtanzahl der Tokens pro Shot als gestapelter Balken dargestellt ist. Die horizontale Achse zeigt die „Number of Shots“ mit den diskreten Werten 0, 1, 2, 3 und 4, während die vertikale Achse die „Token Count“ in einem linearen Bereich von 0 bis 7000 anzeigt, mit horizontalen gestrichelten Hilfslinien in Abständen von 1000. Der erste Balken bei 0 Shots besteht ausschließlich aus orangefarbenen „Reasoning“-Tokens mit einem Wert von 6393. Ab 1 Shot werden zusätzlich blaue „Demonstration“-Tokens hinzugefügt, wobei die orange „Reasoning“-Komponente abnimmt: bei 1 Shot beträgt sie etwa 4441 (mit 1952 Demonstration-Tokens darüber), bei 2 Shot etwa 4830 (mit 1613 Demonstration-Tokens), bei 3 Shot etwa 5000 (mit 1040 Demonstration-Tokens) und bei 4 Shot etwa 4700 (mit 1379 Demonstration-Tokens). Rote Pfeile mit negativen Zahlen über den blauen Segmenten deuten auf die Reduktion der Reasoning-Tokens im Vergleich zum Zero-Shot-Fall hin, wobei die Werte -1952, -1613, -1040 und -1379 jeweils die Differenz zwischen dem Reasoning-Anteil bei 0 Shots und dem entsprechenden Reasoning-Anteil bei den jeweiligen Shots darstellen. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern nach aufsteigender Shot-Anzahl angeordnet, und es gibt keine visuelle Hervorhebung außer den roten Pfeilen und Zahlen, die die Abnahme der Reasoning-Tokens kennzeichnen.
